import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int dest;
        long cap;
        long flow;
        int rev;

        Edge(int d, long c, int r) {
            dest = d;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int V, s, t;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int[] dist;
        int[] work;

        FlowNetwork(int nodes, int src, int dst) {
            V = nodes;
            s = src;
            t = dst;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            dist = new int[V];
            work = new int[V];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long capacity) {
            adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, capacity, adj.get(v).size()));
            adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, adj.get(u).size() - 1));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            dist[s] = 0;
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (e.cap - e.flow > 0 && dist[e.dest] == -1) {
                        dist[e.dest] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dest);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            for (int i = work[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                work[u] = i;
                Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                if (dist[e.dest] == dist[u] + 1 && e.cap - e.flow > 0) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.dest, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        adj.get(e.dest).get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long result = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(work, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    result += pushed;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static int[][] fireTime = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] reachTime = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] idMap = new int[150][150];
    static int N, Tlimit;
    static List<String> mapGrid, capGrid;

    static List<int[]> getAdj(int r, int c) {
        List<int[]> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (r + 1 < N) res.add(new int[]{r+1, c});
        if (r - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r-1, c});
        if (c + 1 < N) res.add(new int[]{r, c+1});
        if (c - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r, c-1});
        return res;
    }

    static void fireSpread(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fireTime[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        fireTime[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur[0], c = cur[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : getAdj(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                char ch = mapGrid.get(nr).charAt(nc);
                if ((ch != 'Z' && !Character.isDigit(ch)) || fireTime[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                fireTime[nr][nc] = fireTime[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(mapGrid.get(i).charAt(j)) && fireTime[i][j] == -1) {
                    fireTime[i][j] = Tlimit;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void reachSpread(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(reachTime[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        reachTime[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur[0], c = cur[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : getAdj(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                if (!Character.isDigit(mapGrid.get(nr).charAt(nc)) || reachTime[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                reachTime[nr][nc] = reachTime[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Tlimit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mapGrid = new ArrayList<>();
        capGrid = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            mapGrid.add(br.readLine());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            capGrid.add(br.readLine());
        }

        int fireR = -1, fireC = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                idMap[i][j] = i * N + j + 1;
                if (mapGrid.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    fireR = i;
                    fireC = j;
                }
            }
        }

        fireSpread(fireR, fireC);

        int totalNodes = 2 * N * N + 2;
        FlowNetwork network = new FlowNetwork(totalNodes, 0, totalNodes - 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(mapGrid.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int people = mapGrid.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                    network.addEdge(0, idMap[i][j], people);
                    reachSpread(i, j);
                    for (int r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < N; c++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(capGrid.get(r).charAt(c)) && reachTime[r][c] != -1 &&
                                reachTime[r][c] <= fireTime[r][c] && reachTime[r][c] <= Tlimit) {
                                boolean valid = true;
                                if (reachTime[r][c] == fireTime[r][c]) {
                                    valid = false;
                                    for (int[] neighbor : getAdj(r, c)) {
                                        int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                                        if (reachTime[nr][nc] != -1 &&
                                            reachTime[nr][nc] < fireTime[nr][nc]) {
                                            valid = true;
                                            break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (valid) {
                                    network.addEdge(idMap[i][j], N * N + idMap[r][c], people);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(capGrid.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int cap = capGrid.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                    network.addEdge(N * N + idMap[i][j], totalNodes - 1, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(network.maxFlow());
    }
}
